clips.title: The story
paras: In Dolanaar, Tallonkai Swiftroot watches the woods as corruption spreads beneath Teldrassil’s boughs. He sends young adventurers to recover enchanted relics and check the foul forces troubling the forest.

Tallonkai Swiftroot watches the woods from Dolanaar, the settlement in Teldrassil’s canopy. Like many night elves beneath the newly grown World Tree, he is alarmed by wildlife acting in unnatural ways and shadows gathering at the edges of their homes.

Tallonkai sends adventurers against the foul beings disturbing Teldrassil’s peace. Corrupted dream catchers threaten the sleep of druids, while gnarlpine furbolgs have grown vicious under a dark malaise. Ferocitas the Dream Eater leads corrupted Gnarlpine mystics. Tallonkai seeks to cleanse these threats and defend the Kaldorei’s fragile home.
